name: Vase with Chi-Dragon Handles and Flowers and Birds
material: porcelain painted in polychrome enamels over transparent glaze
summary: This four-sided vase with ovoid body, spreading foot, and short neck is decorated with birds, trees, and flowers in various enamels. The two dragon handles are decorated with floral designs in gold on a rouge-de-fer ground.
